info.title: pleroma loom API
info.description: The loom inference server. Every route is served at `/api/v1/<route>`; the un-prefixed paths are same-origin legacy aliases for loom_ui.html. Bearer auth applies when the server has a token (--api-token / $PLEROMA_API_TOKEN). See docs/API.md.

get.summary: what this server is: map, prompt mode, rulers, policies, dose band, API version
one session's histories, wear, current fan and probe
get.description: Legacy alias (same-origin, un-prefixed): `GET /state`. v1 NEVER creates the session: an unknown session is 404 `no_session`. The legacy alias creates it.

get.summary: every session, on disk and in memory
a running /loom or /probe's stage and harvest
get.description: Legacy alias (same-origin, un-prefixed): `GET /loom/progress`. v1 never creates the session (an unknown one reads `progress: null`); the legacy alias creates it.

parameters.name: session
parameters.description: the session tag; empty reads nothing

get.summary: harvest worker health, probed on request (2 s cache)
the atlas report (dead path, kept for a decision)
this document: the OpenAPI 3.1 description of /api/v1

post.summary: say a turn on a branch (worn on `loom`)
post.description: Legacy alias (same-origin, un-prefixed): `POST /chat`. Mutating: a session snapshot is written after success.

post.summary: draw K futures of a contemplated turn; score, optionally probe and auto-wear
post.description: Legacy alias (same-origin, un-prefixed): `POST /loom`. Mutating: a session snapshot is written after success.

post.summary: score the current fan with the probe gauge (optionally wear the pick)
post.description: Legacy alias (same-origin, un-prefixed): `POST /probe`. Mutating: a session snapshot is written after success.

post.summary: wear a candidate of the current fan
post.description: Legacy alias (same-origin, un-prefixed): `POST /wear`. Mutating: a session snapshot is written after success.

post.summary: wear a lever from no draw (dead path, kept for a decision)
post.description: Legacy alias (same-origin, un-prefixed): `POST /wear_code`. Mutating: a session snapshot is written after success.

post.summary: pop the last exchange (returned, not discarded)
post.description: Legacy alias (same-origin, un-prefixed): `POST /undo`. Mutating: a session snapshot is written after success.

post.summary: redraw the last reply under the current wear
post.description: Legacy alias (same-origin, un-prefixed): `POST /reroll`. Mutating: a session snapshot is written after success.

post.summary: replace the last user turn and regenerate
post.description: Legacy alias (same-origin, un-prefixed): `POST /edit`. Mutating: a session snapshot is written after success.

post.summary: cut a branch back to its first keep_turns exchanges
post.description: Legacy alias (same-origin, un-prefixed): `POST /truncate`. Mutating: a session snapshot is written after success.
Legacy alias (same-origin, un-prefixed): `POST /unwear`. Mutating: a session snapshot is written after success.

post.summary: forget the session entirely (the snapshot records the cleared session)
post.description: Legacy alias (same-origin, un-prefixed): `POST /reset`. Mutating: a session snapshot is written after success.

post.summary: reload one session from its snapshot

AutoSpec.description:
/loom's ``auto`` object: pick a candidate by ``policy`` and wear it.

``from_mapping`` performs the do_loom coercions in their original order;
``lever_kind``/``dose_policy`` stay raw here and are resolved (and refused,
with their codes) by ``resolve_lever_kind``/``resolve_dose_policy`` exactly
where they always were — after ``pick_auto``.

ProbeSpec.description:
The probe's settings: /loom's ``probe`` object, or /probe's whole body.

``from_mapping`` performs run_probe's coercions in their original order
(alpha, reps, horizon, base, n_base); the range checks stay in run_probe.
``wear`` is read (and type-checked) by do_probe, after the probe ran — it
is only meaningful on /probe.
